Trade-off of the fix, for the reviewer. push-fold now defers, with a green run and a '::notice title=Fold deferred::', any version group whose notes file is absent. That holds whether a late tag caused it or a build job that omitted the file. Driven in s5: the build rendered pi-legion_99.1.0.md, it was deleted, and push-fold deferred it with exit 0. Before this fix that case was refused. A faulty or compromised build can therefore only delay a version group, never write wrong text. A fold-notes bug that drops a group would show as a notice on each run, not as a red run. main@ groups and notes that exist but are not regular files are still refused, which s5 and the implementer's tests show.
